helpAuction: a <n> <suit>         Bid in the auction (n is 5 or more; suit 1:S 2:C 3:H 4:D)
helpPass: pass                 Drop out of the auction
scoreTable: Score: exact +(call^2 + 10); an exact 0 is +25; missing costs -(10 x the difference). All four exact or all four missing doubles either way.
promptAuction: Bid with a <n> <suit> (n is 5 or more), or pass to drop out.
promptBid: Call the tricks you expect to take (b <0-13>).
promptBidQuota: You won the auction, so you must call at least {{n}}.
promptBidRestricted: You call last, so {{n}} is barred -- it would make the total 13.
hintReasonAuctionBid: this hand is worth winning the auction with
hintReasonAuctionPass: not worth winning the auction -- drop out
hintReasonMeetQuota: you must meet the quota you won
hintReasonAvoidRestricted: your estimate is the barred number, so shift by one
hintReasonWinTrick: you are short of your call -- go for this trick
hintReasonDuck: you already have your call -- duck this one
